```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_season <- 2013L # final college seasons, approximately the 2014 draft
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
tier_colors <- tier_palette()
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(season >= first_season, season <= last_season) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
tier_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(credited, tier_label))
tr <- function(t, col) tier_rates[[col]][tier_rates$tier_label == t]
power_g5 <- tr("Power", "draft_rate") / tr("Group of 5", "draft_rate")
# Notre Dame as an independent is a one-school Power group; the other
# independents are Group of 5.
fbs_cr <- credited |>
  filter(tier_label != "FCS and below") |>
  mutate(
    league = case_when(
      conference == "FBS Independents" & team == "Notre Dame" ~ "Notre Dame",
      conference == "FBS Independents" ~ "Other FBS independents",
      .default = conference
    )
  )
# A conference's tier is the one most of its eligible players played in.
league_tier <- fbs_cr |>
  count(league, tier_label, wt = n_eligible) |>
  group_by(league) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(league, tier = tier_label)
conf_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_cr, league)) |>
  left_join(league_tier, by = "league") |>
  arrange(desc(draft_rate))
league_season <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_cr, league, season)) |>
  left_join(league_tier, by = "league")
power_line <- tr("Power", "draft_rate")
g5_line <- tr("Group of 5", "draft_rate")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(
  conf_rates,
  aes(draft_rate, reorder(league, draft_rate))
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        league, " (", tier, "): ", fmt(drafted), " drafted of ",
        fmt(eligible), " eligible (", pct(draft_rate), ")"
      ),
      data_id = league
    ),
    fill = "#1B9E77",
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(power_line, g5_line),
    color = "#374151",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Draft rate by FBS conference",
    subtitle = "Eligible players drafted; dashed lines are the Power and Group of Five totals",
    x = "Draft rate",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "power-conference-draft-rate", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
bind_rows(
  tier_rates |>
    transmute(Group = paste("All", tier_label), schools, eligible, drafted, draft_rate),
  conf_rates |>
    transmute(Group = league, schools, eligible, drafted, draft_rate)
) |>
  transmute(
    Group,
    Schools = schools,
    Eligible = fmt(eligible),
    Drafted = fmt(drafted),
    `Draft rate` = pct(draft_rate)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Group", "Schools", "Eligible players", "Drafted", "Draft rate"),
    caption = "Eligible players and draftees by tier and by conference, with each conference's draft rate. A conference's tier is the one most of its eligible players played in. Conference rates use the conference of each player's final season."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: seasons
p_seasons <- ggplot(
  league_season,
  aes(season, draft_rate, color = tier, group = league)
) +
  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(data_id = league, tooltip = league),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      data_id = league,
      tooltip = paste0(
        league, ", ", season, ": ", drafted, " drafted of ", eligible,
        " eligible (", pct(draft_rate), ")"
      )
    ),
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tier_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(first_season, last_season, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Final college season",
    y = "Draft rate",
    title = "Each conference's draft rate, season by season",
    subtitle = "Hover a line to follow one conference; hover a point for its counts",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_seasons)
```
